# Build queue (features learned from repos/files that need code). Kiro: read at the start of every session, build + test the best ones, tick them [x].


- [ ] [audio] Timeline-Mined SFX Cue Generation (lowfatgeek/motion-graphics-skill, 2026-11-17): Instead of manually scripting audio cues, inspect the GSAP master timeline (`window.__timelines['main']`) in headless Chrome, classify tweens into sound families based on property changes (camera moves to whoosh, entrance to impact, text reveal to paper/click), and output frame-snapped cue timestamps. Then mix stem layers and mux onto the final MP4 using `ffmpeg -c:v copy` without re-rendering video frames. HOW: Upgrade `mix.py`: replace manual SFX cue estimation by running a headless timeline query on the HyperFrames composition to extract exact animation hits, generating stem audio prior to ffmpeg muxing.

- [ ] [audio] Staggered Caption Word-Clicks (lowfatgeek/motion-graphics-skill, 2026-11-17): For kinetic or word-by-word captions, unroll the GSAP stagger reveal into individual quiet clicks (typewriter or shutter takes) cued at `at + i * stagger`. Treat these cues as un-metered 'texture' capped at 20 hits/sec and mixed at -19 dB under voiceover, preventing quiet clicks from consuming the budget of major impact/whoosh events. HOW: In `compose_lab.py` and `mix.py`, add a caption-sync audio pass that emits subtle frame-accurate clicks for each highlighted Hinglish word reveal.

- [ ] [review] Mechanical Anti-Slide Preflight Audit (lowfatgeek/motion-graphics-skill, 2026-11-17): Enforce automated layout linting before rendering: reject compositions if >= 3 sequential scenes simply toggle opacity/autoAlpha on static sections, enforce a maximum 2-tier text hierarchy per scene (headline + diegetic label), and flag camera scale changes under 5% as imperceptible Ken Burns drift. Ensure an anchor subject persists across >= 60% of runtime. HOW: Add AST/DOM regex checks into `preflight.py` to inspect generated HyperFrames HTML before passing it to Puppeteer, automatically rejecting slide-like scene hierarchies.

- [ ] [motion] SVG Joint Proxy Transform Wrapper (lowfatgeek/motion-graphics-skill, 2026-11-17): GSAP `transformOrigin` on SVG elements dynamically recalculates based on dynamic bounding boxes, causing rotating joints (limbs, needles, dials) to tear apart during motion. Resolve this using a lightweight transform proxy object `J(el, tx, ty)` that writes explicit `translate() rotate() scale()` attribute strings during GSAP `onUpdate` without directly tweening SVG container coordinates. HOW: Add the `J()` transform proxy helper to our base HyperFrames script template for animated props, dials, and future character rigging in Puraan Ki Katha.

- [ ] [caption] Text Reading Hold Duration Formula (0xS4N4TG/kinetograph-foundation-motion, 2026-11-17): Calculate required static hold durations for kinetic titles, cards, and text overlays using `duration = (word_count * 0.3s) + 0.5s` settle time. At 30 fps, a 3-word title needs at least 1.4s (42 frames) hold before transition or exit. Prevents visual cards and sentence highlights from disappearing before viewers can read them. HOW: In `compose_lab.py`, enforce this formula when generating GSAP timeline hold durations for sentence captions and kinetic titles against TTS voice timings.

- [ ] [motion] Materializing Blur-Translate Enter Preset (0xS4N4TG/kinetograph-foundation-motion, 2026-11-17): Replace harsh fade-ins or slide-ins with Jakub's materializing entrance: simultaneously animate `opacity: 0 -> 1`, `translateY: 8px -> 0px`, and `filter: blur(4px) -> blur(0px)` using a crisp ease-out (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`) or zero-bounce spring over 300-450ms. Blur simulates depth and optical focus, giving UI props physical arrival on dark canvas. HOW: In `compose_lab.py`, upgrade entrance tweens for UI panels, chat bubbles, stat counters, and comparison cards to include the `blur(4px)` to `blur(0px)` transition.

- [ ] [edit] Ease-In Cut-On-Beat Scene Transition (0xS4N4TG/kinetograph-foundation-motion, 2026-11-17): When transitioning into a cut or musical downbeat, never let the outgoing motion settle with ease-out. If a card or camera push transitions across a cut, use ease-in (`cubic-bezier(0.7, 0, 0.84, 0)`) so the cut lands at maximum velocity on or 1 frame before the downbeat, sustaining scene energy. HOW: In `compose.py` and `compose_lab.py`, set outgoing push/pan tweens to ease-in (`power2.in`), aligning cut frame timestamps with downbeats detected in `mix.py`.

- [ ] [motion] Deterministic Sub-1% Handheld Drift (0xS4N4TG/kinetograph-foundation-motion, 2026-11-17): During static holds exceeding 1.5s on HUD cards, charts, or terminal screens, apply continuous deterministic drift under 1% of frame bounds (0.4% translation x/y, 0.2deg rotation) using seeded `noise(seed, frame)`. Prevents visual stagnation and maintains render determinism across headless parallel renders. HOW: In `compose_lab.py`, inject a deterministic noise wrapper to the stage camera container for scenes whose speech duration exceeds 2 seconds.

Compounding more than two effects (e.g., grain + vignette + chromatic aberration + glow + shake) creates generic AI-slop visual artifacts and degrades mobile compression. HOW: In `preflight.py`, parse the generated HyperFrames CSS/filter classes per scene; automatically drop secondary filters if the count of active effects exceeds 2.

- [ ] [motion] Non-Zero Scale Inception Guard (0xS4N4TG/kinetograph-foundation-motion, 2026-11-17): Never animate element scales starting from `scale(0)`. Initialize entering badges, UI cards, and icon pops at `scale: 0.9` with `opacity: 0` before tweening to `scale: 1.0`. HOW: In `compose_lab.py` and `preflight.py`, update and audit all GSAP pop-in tweens to clamp initial scale values to minimum `0.90`.

HOW: In mix.py or mux stage: add post-mux ebur128 true-peak check; if peak > -1 dBTP, re-transcode audio with lower ceiling while copying video.

- [ ] [visual] Carved Key Line: Variable-Width Filled Stroke with Taper & Jitter (lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar, 2026-11-19): carve(x, pts, w, {taper=[.25,.25], seed=1, jit=.22}) densifies points via Catmull-Rom (per=6), computes normals, builds left/right polygons. Width = w*0.5*(0.25+0.75*prof)*(1+jit*vnoise(arclen*.035)). Prof tapers at ends via sin(π/2 * u/taper). Result is a single filled polygon — no stroke() — giving authentic carved-line weight variation. HOW: Add carve() to print.js. Replace all line() calls for key lines (mountain ridges, pine needles, rock facets, wave outlines) with carve(). Tune taper per element (e.g., mountain ridges [.35,.02] and [.02,.4]). Seed per layer for consistent jitter across frames.

- [ ] [visual] Ink-Take Reveal with 12-Level Baren Pressure Masks (lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar, 2026-11-19): TX.reveal[0..12] precomputed: each is a 960x540 alpha mask where threshold = 1.35 - k/12*1.75, base = 1 - (X/W*.75 + Y/H*.25) + (fbm-0.5)*.55. stampLayer() uses reveal k = floor(reveal*12.999), draws source with misregistration shift (shift * (1-ss(reveal*1.6))) onto tmp, then destination-in with TX.reveal[k]. Simulates ink soaking in from top-left under baren pressure. HOW: In print.js buildTextures(), generate TX.reveal[0..12] as shown. In stampLayer(), implement the reveal logic. In compose_ukiyoe.py, drive reveal per layer via revFor(i, g, t) = clamp((t - T.printX[g]) / REVEAL_DUR). REVEAL_DUR=0.34s. Misregistration shift = [5,-4] * (1 - ss(reveal*1.6)).

HOW: Add transition_type enum to plan.py output (zoom_through, inverse_zoom, cut_curve_h, cut_curve_v, waterfall, rack_focus, waterfall_entry, nudge).
